fixes: Package and portable integration tests now default to the installed FL Studio 2024 instead of an extracted D: drive fixture; FLIM_TEST_FL24_DIR supports an explicit alternate directory.
Package verification no longer assumes there can be only one experimental installation. It verifies the required exact build and selected path alongside the reviewed FL25/26 builds.
Both package tests select the installed FL24 in the actual app and verify the experimental notice and available room button without allocating a room or launching FL.

local_cloudflare_tests.scope: Current local source; not deployed by this check

native_harnesses.scope: Existing offline executables; synthetic FL objects/mocked Win32 APIs, not native FL runtime

packaged_alternate_copy.scope: Same exact build alongside the newly installed copy; regression for multiple installation copies

checks: Portable executable self-extracts and opens the actual app
Installed FL24 is discovered and selectable alongside reviewed FL25/26 without changing the user profile
Real local diagnostics include app version, inspected builds and matching native file hashes
No real room allocated and no FL instance launched

initial_package_failure.message: Expected one experimental installation, discovered two
initial_package_failure.cause: Test selected extracted fixture plus new installed FL24; the app correctly discovered both

native_collaboration.reason: Automatic approval review rejected both isolated-runtime launch commands with only "blocked by policy". Neither command executed. No FL test process or test room was created.
native_collaboration.current_license_state: not established; no license/trial/welcome text was visible in the existing window titles; no license values inspected

limitations: FL24 remains explicitly experimental. Installation recognition and offline tests do not establish native project or edit synchronization.
Earlier failed native FL24 results remain historical evidence. Installation alone does not replace a successful collaboration run.
Unknown FL24 patch builds remain refused; this check covers only exact 24.2.2.4597.
Oldest supported build must host a mixed-version room.
No real-time physical MIDI or unrecorded live audio/MIDI check was made.
